verdicts.reason: A: the headline runs to within a few pixels of the 'Shop Flavours' button, which is nearly a collision. The GLACIER wordmark has moved below the headline and grown to almost headline weight, which breaks the reading order. The legal text is squeezed into a narrow column beside the pills, the pill order is reversed, and the top third of the canvas is empty. B: has the same wordmark-below-headline and reversed-pill problems, plus an orphaned 'here' from a bad headline wrap. Its text stack is cramped (brand, subtitle and pills are jammed together) and the legal text sits against the bottom edge. Still, the CTA has clear space, so B is marginally less broken.
